remarks: Discover this charming first-floor apartment located in the heart of Downtown Stamford! This pet-friendly building offers a bright and inviting unit that has been freshly painted throughout and features hardwood floors and an open-concept kitchen with granite countertops. The HOA provides an exceptional range of amenities, including basic cable TV, internet, cooking gas, heat, hot water, insurance, and grounds maintenance, meaning the new owner will only need to cover electricity each month. Residents can enjoy excellent on-site amenities, including a beautiful swimming pool, a well-equipped fitness center, 24-hour security, storage areas, and ample visitor parking. With an unbeatable location just steps from shops, restaurants, and public transportation, this apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort and vibrant downtown living. Come see what makes this home a standout opportunity in Stamford!
